feature: Condition true at the first check (SimForge `when` = level trigger)
description: A car in lane -1 is 10 m ahead from t=0, so "distance < 30 m" already holds when the event first checks it.

clauses: 7.6.1 Triggers and condition groups (OR of groups, AND within)
6.3.4 Vehicle coordinate system (reference point; BoundingBox.Center offset)
oracle.derivation: SimForge `when` fires on the first tick the condition holds, which is OSC conditionEdge="none" with maximumExecutionCount=1 (D-05). The Event enters standby when the Act starts at t=0 and is checked then: freespace distance hypot(5.2, 1.6) = 5.4 m < 30 -> starts at t=0.0. (With conditionEdge="rising", as exported before the F-10 fix, 7.6.4 makes the first check false and the event never starts.)

expect.esminiNote: before the F-10 fix our export said conditionEdge=rising and esmini (correctly for that file) never started the event
